failure_mode_definition: A failure in which individually bounded, locally acceptable or independently mitigated control states combine into an end-to-end pathway that violates a security invariant because assurance is performed locally rather than across the composed execution chain.
failure_threshold: The threshold requires at least two component or control states whose interaction creates a materially different end-to-end security property, an unauthorised pathway or protected-asset effect, and evidence that local rather than composed assurance failed to identify or constrain the chain. Objective success or unauthorised action alone is insufficient.

failure_classification.severity_assessment_basis: S1 reflects a demonstrated critical one-click path to sensitive enterprise data exfiltration through a multi-component chain, with no confirmed live malicious exploitation established in the reviewed disclosure.

failure_classification.failure_scope: composed AI application, rendering, retrieval, network and egress controls
failure_classification.recurrence_pattern: May recur in systems whose component controls are assured independently without end-to-end adversarial pathway analysis.
failure_classification.persistence: Persists until the composed pathway is removed or bounded; individual component fixes may or may not be sufficient.
failure_classification.reproducibility: Testable through authorised end-to-end attack-path analysis that retains component-local assumptions and observes the aggregate effect.
failure_classification.visibility: Low under local assurance; evident only when the full chain is executed or modelled.
